definitions.explanation: The process by which fertile land becomes desert, typically as a result of drought, deforestation, or inappropriate agriculture.

examples.japanese: {砂漠化|さばくか}が{進|すす}んでいる。
{砂漠化|さばくか}を{防|ふせ}ぐために{植林|しょくりん}を{行|おこな}う。
{気候|きこう}{変動|へんどう}と{過|か}{放牧|ほうぼく}が{砂漠化|さばくか}の{主|おも}な{原因|げんいん}だと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: Climate change and overgrazing are said to be the main causes of desertification.

notes:
An environmental term often discussed in the context of global environmental issues.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {砂漠化|さばくか}が{進|すす}む (desertification advances)
- {砂漠化|さばくか}を{防|ふせ}ぐ (to prevent desertification)
- {砂漠化|さばくか}{対策|たいさく} (desertification countermeasures)

RELATED TERMS:
- {砂漠|さばく}: desert
- {干|かん}ばつ: drought
- {緑化|りょくか}: greening, afforestation
